task.wandscape.colony_worker.desc.zh_cn: 像法师一样为小镇干活：接取建造、采集、合成等任务，产出进殖民地仓库。需要主人已建立小镇，并开启女仆的 Home 模式（否则她会一直跟着主人跑）。
task.wandscape.colony_worker.desc.en_us: Work for the town like a mage: takes building, gathering and crafting tasks, with output going to the colony warehouse. Requires the owner to have founded a town and the maid's Home mode to be on (otherwise she keeps following her owner).

task.wandscape.colony_worker.enable_cond.zh_cn: 已开启 Home 模式（不跟随玩家）
task.wandscape.colony_worker.enable_cond.en_us: Home mode is enabled (following the player is off)
